maddeler.e:
يضب (form I)
# يَضِبُّ (yaḍibbu) /ja.dˤib.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of ضَبَّ (ḍabba)
# يُضَبُّ (yuḍabbu) /ju.dˤab.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of ضَبَّ (ḍabba)
# يَضِبَّ (yaḍibba) /ja.dˤib.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of ضَبَّ (ḍabba)
# يُضَبَّ (yuḍabba) /ju.dˤab.ba/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
